title: Screening cathode-coating candidates from a DFT batch
objective: Screen five coating candidates for comparability, convergence and thermodynamic stability before synthesis.

decision_questions.positive_despite_block: Does any candidate with INCAR drift or an unconverged ENCUT series still receive recommend or recommend_with_caveats?
decision_questions.overconfident_language: Does the result describe a metastable candidate with more certainty than the 25 meV/atom convention supports?

traps.CAND-C: Looks best (on the hull, ICSD source) but was run at ENCUT 400 eV against a 520 eV reference.
traps.CAND-E: Only 6 meV/atom above hull, but the last ENCUT step still moves 4 meV/atom.
